title: 1984 AHSME Problem 4
statement: A rectangle intersects a circle as shown: \(AB=4,\) \(BC=5\) and \(DE=3.\) Then \(EF\) equals

solutions.text:
The line through the circle’s center perpendicular to the parallel chords \(BC\) and \(EF\) bisects both. Measured from the rectangle’s left side, the midpoint of \(BC\) is \(4+\frac52,\) while the midpoint of \(EF\) is \(3+\frac{EF}{2}.\) Thus \[ 4+\frac52=3+\frac{EF}{2}, \] giving \(EF=7.\)

Therefore, the correct answer is B.
hints: The perpendicular bisectors of the two parallel chords pass through the same center
Therefore the midpoints of \(BC\) and \(EF\) have the same horizontal position
